surface: Editor, DiffEditor, loader, useMonaco, and the complete upstream 4.7.0 prop and callback type surface, including controlled values, model paths, languages, themes, options, view-state restoration, validation, and model ownership.
divergences: The components are compiled Octane components and accept Octane renderables for loading content; they do not depend on React.
Model disposal is ownership-aware: a component only disposes models it created, and it cleans up superseded owned path models on unmount instead of leaking them.
ssr: Editor and DiffEditor render a deterministic loading shell without touching browser globals; live Monaco construction begins in a client effect. Hydration is not yet separately verified.
notes: Pinned to @monaco-editor/react 4.7.0, @monaco-editor/loader 1.7.0, and validated against monaco-editor 0.55.1 used by Echo.
